title: Fan fiction site AO3 says it could take two to four weeks to restore service after a security incident; AO3 hosts 18M+ works and has 11M+ registered users (Bruce Gil/Gizmodo)
summary: Bruce Gil / Gizmodo: Fan fiction site AO3 says it could take two to four weeks to restore service after a security incident; AO3 hosts 18M+ works and has 11M+ registered users — “Black October” comes for the fan fic. — The popular fan fiction website Archive of Our Own (AO3) went offline Thursday, and its millions of users are freaking out.
contentText:
Bruce Gil / Gizmodo :

Fan fiction site AO3 says it could take two to four weeks to restore service after a security incident; AO3 hosts 18M+ works and has 11M+ registered users   —  “Black October” comes for the fan fic.  —  The popular fan fiction website Archive of Our Own (AO3) went offline Thursday, and its millions of users are freaking out.
